definitions.explanation: The outer covering of the human body. More technical/medical than {肌|はだ}.

examples.japanese: {皮膚|ひふ}が{乾燥|かんそう}している。
{紫外線|しがいせん}は{皮膚|ひふ}に{悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Ultraviolet rays have a bad effect on the skin.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{皮膚|ひふ}が{乾燥|かんそう}して、かゆくなることがある。
examples.english: In winter, the skin can become dry and itchy.

examples.japanese: {皮膚|ひふ}に{赤|あか}い{発疹|ほっしん}が{出|で}たので、すぐに{皮膚科|ひふか}を{受診|じゅしん}した。
examples.english: I got a red rash on my skin, so I immediately visited a dermatologist.

notes:
{皮膚|ひふ} is the formal/medical term for skin — the outer covering of the body.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {皮膚科|ひふか}: dermatology
- {皮膚|ひふ}{炎|えん}: dermatitis, skin inflammation
- {皮膚|ひふ}{病|びょう}: skin disease
- {皮膚|ひふ}{科医|かい}: dermatologist
- {皮膚|ひふ}{移植|いしょく}: skin graft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肌|はだ}: skin (everyday, often about texture/appearance)
- {素肌|すはだ}: bare skin
- {地肌|じはだ}: bare skin, scalp

USAGE:
{皮膚|ひふ} is the technical/medical term, while {肌|はだ} is the everyday word. {肌|はだ}がきれい (beautiful skin) is natural; {皮膚|ひふ}がきれい sounds clinical. However, {皮膚科|ひふか} (dermatology) is a very common word even in everyday life.
